# sigma_workbook (Data Source)

Look up a workbook by `id` (preferred) or by `path` (e.g. `My Documents/Reports/Q4`). Workbooks are not creatable via Sigma's REST API; create them in the UI and reference here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single workbook by ID.
data "sigma_workbook" "production" {
  id = "<workbook-id-here>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Workbook UUID.
- `path` (String) Slash-separated path.

### Read-Only

- `latest_version` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `url_id` (String)
